_PAGE_FILTER_INITIALS_DESCRIPTION_: The function filterInitials returns the initials of a name, e.g. for an avatar. If a name has more words than the limit, the initials of the first words and of the last word are used.
_PAGE_FILTER_INITIALS_ARGUMENTS_IS_UPPER: Whether the initials are converted to uppercase
_PAGE_FILTER_INITIALS_AVATAR_DESCRIPTION: Together with the class a_rounded_circle. The initials are hidden from screen readers with aria-hidden, because the name is shown next to them.
